title: Psychedelic Celestial Spiral
description: A surreal circular composition features four colorful female profiles in red, green, blue and orange, each facing different directions around a glowing central spiral staircase. The sphere is set against a black background with dripping rainbow paint from the top, white line art leaves and stars, and a cracked pathway leading toward it at the bottom.
prompt: Surreal circular artwork on black background featuring four female side profiles in red, green, blue and orange facing outward around a glowing spiral staircase that ascends through concentric circles. A green crescent moon appears in the upper left of the sphere. White line-art leaves and stars float around the orb. Thick dripping rainbow paint in all colors flows from the top edge down over the sphere and onto a cracked earthy pathway below.
